_source.purpose: Where to go to obtain a credential for each imported provider.
_source.whyThisFileExists: The OmniRoute roster carries access, terms and token economics, and the resolution file carries endpoints and auth shape — but neither carries a URL for obtaining a key. OmniRoute's per-provider registry entries have no website field either (checked against their live tree), so this fact has no upstream owner and is curated here rather than invented at import time.
_source.ownership: Hand-maintained and not generated. `url`, `evidence` and `note` are written by a person; `verifiedAt` and `httpStatus` are stamped by the tool. Re-running the OmniRoute sync never touches this file, which is the point: upstream has no opinion to overwrite it with.
whatCounts: A page that issues or displays a credential, or the signup page that leads to one. `evidence` says which kind of page it is, so a marketing homepage never passes as a key page by accident.
A provider with no reachable public page is absent on purpose. Its card renders as a plain heading, which is the honest state: there is nowhere to send the user.
A service with no credential at all (a keyless relay) is recorded with that fact rather than left blank, because the link is still the right place to send someone.
_source.readingTheChecks: `httpStatus` is the status of the last live check and `note` explains anything that makes that number misleading. This environment's egress is filtered: several hosts time out and a few do not resolve at all, which is a statement about the sandbox and not about the URL. Those entries keep their URL and record the inconclusive check in `note` instead of being silently dropped.

mistral.note: The check establishes no connection to this host at all from the dev environment while sibling consoles answer, so the result is inconclusive rather than negative; the path is Mistral's own documented keys page.

llm7.evidence: LLM7's token page, where its free tokens are issued

gemini.evidence: Google AI Studio; API keys page

cloudflare-ai.evidence: Cloudflare dashboard; API tokens page (Workers AI also needs an account ID)

sambanova.note: Timed out from this environment; the page itself is named verbatim by SambaNova's own docs.

huggingface.evidence: Hugging Face settings; access tokens (a read token reaches the Inference Providers router)

glm-cn.evidence: BigModel (Zhipu) user center; API keys page
glm-cn.note: Timed out from this environment; the exact path is cited by Zhipu-facing tooling.

baidu.evidence: Baidu Qianfan console; the application page that issues the key
baidu.note: Timed out from this environment; the path comes from Qianfan's own SDK docs.

kilo-gateway.evidence: Kilo homepage; the gateway credential is issued from the account here

vertex.evidence: Google Cloud console; credentials page (Vertex authenticates with a service account, not a bearer key)

predibase.evidence: Predibase console; API token under Settings
predibase.note: This environment's resolver cannot find the host, so the check is inconclusive rather than negative. Predibase was acquired by Rubrik, so expect the console to move.

doubao.evidence: Volcengine console; the Ark page that issues the Doubao API key

ai21.evidence: AI21 Studio; API keys under Settings (per AI21's own create-an-api-key guide)
ai21.note: Signed-out visitors are redirected to ai21.com, so the keys page sits behind the sign-in.

bytez.evidence: Bytez homepage; the dashboard behind signup issues the key

nebius.evidence: Nebius Token Factory; the get-an-API-key entry point

qoder.evidence: Qoder homepage; the account behind signup issues the API key

baichuan.evidence: Baichuan platform console; API key page

blackbox.evidence: Blackbox router page; one API key covers its models

coze.evidence: Coze open platform; the page behind this issues personal access tokens

friendliai.evidence: Friendli Suite; Settings then API Keys

iflytek.evidence: iFlytek open platform console; API keys

monsterapi.evidence: MonsterAPI homepage; its dashboard's Auth Keys section issues the key
monsterapi.note: This environment's resolver cannot find the host, so the check is inconclusive rather than negative.

nlpcloud.evidence: NLP Cloud dashboard; API token page

reka.evidence: Reka platform; API keys in the dashboard

sensenova.evidence: SenseCore console; the page that issues SenseNova tokens

sparkdesk.evidence: iFlytek open platform console; Spark (SparkDesk) keys are issued here

stepfun.evidence: StepFun open platform; the get-an-API-key entry point

arcee-ai.evidence: Arcee AI homepage; the console behind signup issues the key

huggingchat.evidence: HuggingChat; a Hugging Face token is what authenticates it
